definitions: A brand of clear, removable aligners used as an alternative to traditional metal braces for straightening teeth.
The orthodontic treatment system that uses a series of custom-made, clear plastic aligners to gradually shift teeth into their desired position.
examples: She decided to get Invisalign to correct her smile.
Many adults prefer Invisalign for its discreet appearance.
The dentist recommended Invisalign for his minor misalignment.
